changes.title: Call or text from any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage shrinks on a phone and the number cannot be tapped. The sketch puts a tap to call or text button at the top.

changes.title: A free estimate request up front.
changes.text: Free estimates are listed on the Services page. The sketch adds a Request a free estimate button right under the headline.

changes.title: Your services at a glance.
changes.text: Air conditioning, heating, mini splits and after hours service lead the page.
